sections.description: A unified, modular workspace platform for any business industry. Supports Real Estate agencies, Photography Studios, and more — all in one plugin with dynamic module switching, industry onboarding, and one-click auto-updates.
sections.changelog:
v4.8.20

  • Reviews & Feedback Sidebar Navigation Polish: Removed the lock/SOON padlock badge from the Reviews & Feedback sidebar navigation item across Photography Studio, Real Estate, and Custom workspace modules while retaining the high-converting Early Access intent capture and feature priority voting interface inside the view.

v4.8.19

  • Desktop Viewport Visibility & Global CSS Isolation Fix: Purged un-namespaced .hidden, [hidden] { display: none !important; } override in accordance with Rule #8. This restores full display of the User Management workspace header, navigation tabs, desktop filter selects, and responsive data tables that utilize Tailwind's hidden md:block and hidden md:flex classes across all subpages.

v4.8.18

  • Global Universal Voice AI Layer & Mic Trigger Fix: Hoisted the Universal Voice AI Drawer markup and JavaScript engine (coraTriggerVoiceAI, coraCloseUniversalVoice, coraToggleUniversalVoiceRecording) to global platform scope, eliminating the coraTriggerVoiceAI is not a function exception when triggering voice search from ⌘K Command Palette, Island Nav, and CRM subpages.
  • Elevated voice drawer z-index (1000001) to cleanly overlay active command modals.

v4.8.17

  • Reviews & Feedback Early Access & Coming Soon Architecture: Rebuilt Reviews & Feedback screen into a high-converting, monochromatic Early Access and Intent Capture view.
  • Added SOON padlock badge across Photography Studio, Real Estate, and Custom workspace sidebar navigation.
  • Integrated interactive priority feature voter pills and AJAX waitlist registration via cora_capture_feature_intent.

v4.8.16

  • User & Roles Multi-Tenant View & Rendering Architecture Fix: Resolved empty table and cards rendering on /workspace/team-roles by upgrading cora_get_agency_identifiers and multitenant user scoping to dynamically include photography studio, real estate, and workspace owner accounts.
  • Eliminated duplicate DOM ID collisions and restored full-width responsive table layouts, mobile cards, search filtering, and empty state cards.

v4.8.15

  • Multi-Language Workspace Persistence & Translation Engine Fix across Web App and standalone PWA.
  • Fixed language resetting automatically to English by removing unconditional server-side override.
  • Enabled authenticated workspace users to persist language preferences in user meta, workspace options, and cookies.
  • Added server-side selected hydration for all 14 supported languages and active language badge labels.

4.8.14

  • Profile Password Drawer Edge-Aligned Bottom Sheet Architecture: Migrated password reset and avatar crop drawers to the golden standard bottom sheet system. Completely removed bottom margin/padding gaps, resolved pointer-events and focusability blocking, and enabled full typing, keyboard submission, and click-outside dismissal across desktop and mobile.

4.8.13

  • Profile Usability & Mobile Password Drawer Resiliency: Hoisted global popover handlers to guarantee zero topbar profile exceptions across subpages. Fixed password drawer touch typing, input focusability, enter key submission, backdrop click dismissal, and lazy avatar canvas initialization.

4.8.12

  • Organisation Deposit & Cash-Flow Optimisation Engine: Deployed high-throughput multi-tier deposit calculator with GST SAC 998381 compliance, automated working capital risk mitigations, milestone cashflow schedules, and sub-millisecond server-side transient caching.

4.8.11

  • Custom Workspace Mode Adaptive Shortcuts: Enhanced Quick Action Shortcuts to adapt dynamically for Custom Workspace mode by inspecting enabled module candidate maps and rendering industry-tailored actions with 5-action limit safeguards.

4.8.10

  • Platform Synchronization & Server Release: Synchronized all core workspace modules, micro-cache layer, multitenant isolation pipelines, and unified codebase architecture to production main baseline.

4.8.8

  • Editor Session Update Guard: Fully isolated Canvas Site Builder and Elementor editor sessions from background PWA version checks, visibility change reload triggers, and auto-update prompts, ensuring active design sessions never suffer unwanted page reloads.

4.8.7

  • Eliminated Editor Auto-Refresh Loop & Instant Iframe Sync: Removed client-side DOM mutation on Elementor's Backbone/Marionette select view which was triggering Elementor's internal preview reload cycle. Added direct inline onload event to the editor iframe to immediately dismiss the spawning loader.

4.8.5

  • Synchronized 2-Option Page Layout System: Filtered theme page templates and Elementor Document Page Settings across PHP filters (theme_page_templates, theme_templates) and Elementor controls (elementor/element/document_settings/before_section_end) to strictly expose only 2 clean, synchronized layout options: Default (Header & Footer) and Canvas (No Header / Footer), purging all legacy third-party/WooCommerce template clutter.

4.8.4

  • Solution-Oriented Canvas Self-Healing Engine: Guaranteed zero-error experience during Elementor builder sessions. Added automated elementor-preview query routing in pre_get_posts to resolve all draft/canvas pages without 404s, and transformed cryptic Elementor preview modals into clean, solution-focused 1-click action cards ('Open Direct Canvas' and 'Retry Sync').

4.8.3

  • Canvas Editor Iframe Security & Dialog Fix: Resolved false-positive 'Preview Security Blocked (HTTP 403)' card by refining iframe error observers to ignore hidden Elementor modal templates, and configured wildcard multi-tenant CSP frame-ancestors headers so Elementor loads seamlessly inside Canvas.

4.8.2

  • Platform Performance Optimization (<3s Guarantee): Eliminated synchronous remote GitHub update checks and PageSpeed blocking calls from page load pipeline; added static memory and 24h transient caching for database schema queries (cora_table_exists, cora_column_exists, cora_db_get_agency_id); eliminated N+1 database queries in Forms module with batch eager-loading.
  • Realistic Atomic Skeleton Loading System: Expanded skeleton overlay with 8 specialized realistic geometries matching exact UI layouts (Dashboard, 5-Column CRM Kanban, Financials Co-founder, 7-Column Document Vault, 3-Pane Split Inbox, 7-Day Calendar Schedule, Canvas Site Builder, and Settings Suite); hooked instant pre-navigation skeleton preloader and dynamic in-view skeleton helpers.

4.8.1

  • Page Layout Frame Selection: Replaced legacy style template options with clean Cora page layout modes in the Add Page modal (Default (Header & Footer) vs Canvas (No Header / Footer)) and synchronized backend Elementor template configuration.

4.8.0

  • Unified Multitenant Production Release: Production release consolidating complete WordPress admin lockdown, direct Elementor builder Canvas integration, robust multitenant URL routing (/site/{workspaceslug}/{pageslug}), and instant cache-busting deployment pipeline.

4.7.9

  • Canonical Redirect Prevention on /site/ Routes: Added strict suppression of WordPress core canonical redirects on all /site/ tenant routes, ensuring fallback workspace resolution and instant HTTP 200 responses.

4.7.8

  • Multitenant /site/{workspaceslug}/{pageslug} Structure: Standardized all public frontend routes, preview bar page switcher dropdowns, and tenant link normalizers to use the requested /site/{workspaceslug}/ for homepage and /site/{workspaceslug}/{pageslug} for subpages with seamless query parameter persistence.

4.7.7

  • Elementor Back-to-Canvas Route Fix: Fixed top Elementor toolbar Theme Dashboard navigation to resolve directly to the active workspace Canvas builder route (/{workspace_slug}/canvas) rather than redirecting to the primary workspace dashboard.
  • Complete WordPress Admin Lockdown: Strictly intercepted and redirected all legacy/default WordPress admin pages (/wp-admin/*) to the white-labeled Workspace dashboard or login portal while preserving necessary backend AJAX/REST and Elementor builder session capabilities.
  • Tenant Site Menu Normalization: Fully normalized all internal menu and page permalinks to resolve cleanly under tenant-scoped workspace URLs (/site/{workspace_slug}/...) with draft theme preview persistence.
  • Menus Table Width & Character Constraints: Added strict table-fixed layout and input length limits to prevent unbroken text overflow across the Menus tab and Detail Editor.

4.7.6

  • Dynamic Multitenant URL Architecture & Homepage Router: Configured full multitenant website URL routing (/{workspaceSlug} for homepage and /{workspaceSlug}/{pageSlug} for subpages). Seamlessly distinguishes admin routes (/{workspaceSlug}/dashboard) from public tenant routes, resolves live/draft theme candidates across multi-agency databases, and routes homepage assignments with HTTP 200 responses.
  • Canvas Preview Link Synchronization: Synchronized all header buttons, theme card iframes, and page table preview links to point directly to the tenant's workspace-scoped URLs with clean slug structure.

4.7.5

  • Canvas Homepage Designation & Preview Router: Automatically designates the imported theme's best homepage candidate on Elementor kit import and updates the theme preview query routing so draft and live preview cards always display that theme's designated homepage.
  • Level 1 Layout Restructure & Collapsible Performance Toggle: Repositioned Draft Themes library directly below the Active Theme card and converted the Performance Insights breakdown and Improve INP recommendation banner into a sleek, collapsible toggle section below Draft Themes.
  • Selector Fix & Automated Test Isolation: Fixed unescaped selector syntax in draft list expander and added automatic database teardown hooks in test suite to prevent test drafts from leaking into production workspace.

4.1.5

  • Reverted to Previous Micro-Scale State: Restored micro-scale KPI card presentation with vector SVG indicator badges as requested.

4.1.4

  • Icon Removal & Definitive Typography Fix for Telemetry KPI Cards: Resolved the font size fallback error (caused by uncompiled arbitrary Tailwind classes) by enforcing explicit inline font styles (11px title, 14px bold mono value, 9.5px context badge) in clean title case without text distortion. Removed vector icon blocks from the 4 telemetry cards for a sleek, clean, uninterrupted data card appearance with zero text truncation.

4.1.3

  • Reverted to Previous Dashboard Layout: Restored the previous compact telemetry metrics card hierarchy and balanced section spacing (mb-8 sm:mb-11 telemetry gap, mt-8 sm:mb-11 search gap, mb-24 sm:mb-28 / 96px quick actions gap) with full original metric titles.

4.1.2

  • Refined Crisp Typography & Expanded Dashboard Spacing: Eliminated awkward text truncation and letter distortion across top telemetry cards (switched to clean, concise labels like Pipeline, Leads, Tours, Vault, Gear with standard crisp 10-11px font rendering and zero text clipping). Further expanded vertical layout whitespace: mb-14 sm:mb-16 below telemetry, mt-10 sm:mt-14 above search, and mb-28 sm:mb-36 (110px) below quick actions into guidance insight cards.

4.1.1

  • Enhanced Visual Spacing & Section Gaps Polish: Expanded breathing room across the top dashboard hierarchy: increased vertical separation between telemetry cards and greeting heading (mb-8 sm:mb-11), between greeting heading and command search bar (mt-8 sm:mt-11), and between quick action shortcut pills and guidance insight decision cards (mb-24 sm:mb-28, 96px). Optimized card width bounds to prevent label truncation.

4.1.0

  • Ultra-Compact Micro Telemetry KPI Cards: Scaled down the 4 KPI cards to a sleek micro footprint (42px height, 480px centered desktop bar, 2x2 grid on mobile). Refined typography and vector SVG icon badges for a minimal, unobtrusive situational awareness bar that seamlessly complements the AI greeting and search header.

4.0.9

  • Always-4 KPI Cards Matrix with 50% Centered Width & Mobile 2-Cols Grid: Fixed Custom workspace mode to always guarantee exactly 4 dynamic KPI cards from enabled feature candidates and intelligent fallback pool. Scaled container to a centered max-w-[620px] on desktop (50% card width reduction) with responsive 2-column (2x2) grid layout on mobile screens.

4.0.8

  • Compact 50% Scale Telemetry KPI Cards Bar (Zero Emojis & 100% Genuine Data): Scaled the top KPI metrics cards to a 50% compact footprint (~58px height) with sleek single-line numeric alignment and 12px vector SVG icons. Enforced 100% genuine database counts with zero dummy defaults and strict zero-emoji styling dynamically tailored for Real Estate, Photography Studio, and Custom workspace industries.

4.0.7

  • Uniform & Approachable Telemetry KPI Cards Bar: Overhauled the top dashboard metrics row from bare naked text into 4 uniform, high-fidelity micro KPI cards with subtle borders, soft elevations, industry-specific vector icons, bold mono values, and live context badges (e.g. 4 Deals · Negotiating, ● 45s AI Speed, 📅 Next: Sat 4:00 PM, ✓ E-Sign Verified). Purged irrelevant dummy metrics to provide high-clarity situational awareness.

4.0.6

  • Approachable Industry Micro-UI Creatives & Real-Time Decision Cards: Replaced abstract shapes and generic icons in the 5 guidance cards with high-clarity, approachable micro-UI previews. Includes real-time Speed-to-Lead WhatsApp chat snippets with instant AI qualification response, live Deal Velocity cards with closing probability meters and showing schedules, Multi-Channel social carousel/brochure studio previews, visual 4-step autonomous drip timeline stepper with live queue counts, and Google Maps Local Pack #1 ranking radar cards tailored dynamically for Real Estate and Studio workspaces.

4.0.5

  • Quick Action Shortcuts 2-Line Alignment & Custom Gradient Pill: Aligned dashboard quick action shortcuts bar into a structured 2-line layout (Line 1: primary operational action pills, Line 2: custom user shortcuts and Custom Shortcuts trigger). Styled the Custom Shortcuts chip with an animated rotating holographic gradient border (.cora-ai-gradient-pill), purple vector icon, and integrated searchable modal page destination picker.

4.0.4

  • PWA Service Worker Error Handling & URL Sanitization Fix: Sanitized raw Service Worker registration script URLs using esc_url_raw() in JavaScript contexts to prevent HTML entity encoding (&) bugs. Added .catch() handlers on all reg.update() and registration.update() calls and suppressed non-fatal ServiceWorker background sync errors in the global unhandledrejection listener, eliminating unhandled promise error toasts during browser background fetches.

4.0.3

  • Shopify & SaaS Visual Dashboard Overhaul: Replaced legacy dashboard layout with the exact Shopify-style 5-guidance card grid, top mini telemetry metrics row (Sessions, Total Sales, Orders, Conversion Rate), greeting and AI Co-founder subtitle, command search bar, and centered quick action pills bar matching the approved production design mockup with 100% visual fidelity.

4.0.2

  • Dashboard Visual Hierarchy & AI Command Polish: Reorganized dashboard layout to follow a top-to-bottom Co-Founder command flow (Hero Greeting → Universal AI Command Search with ⌘K → Monochromatic Quick Action Pills → 4-Card KPI Telemetry Matrix → Operational Bento Grid). Fixed greeting timezone evaluation with client-side dynamic hydration and made the AI Command bar responsive on mobile viewports.

4.0.1

  • Mobile Routing & Subtab Isolation Fix: Resolved mobile reload redirection to Leads CRM by scoping lead subtab auto-selection strictly to the Leads view, removing sub_page query parameter mutations from replaceState, and making explicit URL path segments the primary source of truth in the server router.

4.0.0

  • Major Platform Upgrade v4.0.0 & Unified Clean Slate: Consolidated platform modules into a single, unified main release. Includes strict multi-tenant workspace isolation across CRM, Document Vault, Media Studio, and Financial Co-Founder, dynamic data bridges, autonomous AI co-founder deck, and responsive client portals. Complete test suite verification achieved.

3.4.63

  • Official App Icon & Splash Screens Integration: Deployed official waveform brand app icon pack (dark/light, 512px, 192px, 180px apple-touch-icon, and 64px browser favicon). Configured automatic background PWA icon refresh and cache invalidation in service worker (v3.4.63) with maskable icon support. Updated platform splash screens with high-resolution dark/light brand artwork and animated loading ring.
  • Brand Header Typography Polish: Updated top header brand logo to uppercase CORA in Inter Bold (700 weight, -0.01em tracking) with SVG icon removed across desktop and mobile headers.
  • Published Canvas Dual-Device Preview Fix: Dynamic homepage permalink resolution prevents preview iframes and action buttons from loading the admin dashboard route.

3.4.62

  • Dashboard Quick Action Toolbar Spacing & Gaps Optimization: Increased horizontal and vertical gaps (gap-x-3 gap-y-3.5, py-2) on the dashboard quick action shortcuts bar, preventing wrapped items (e.g. Custom Shortcuts) from colliding with top-row action chips. Removed lightning emoji from suggested presets header.

3.4.61

  • AI Co-Founder Live Flickering Status Beacons & Emoji Purge: Replaced static emoji dots across AI Co-founder Briefing, Sub-Agent Monitors, and Diagnostics cards with sleek, live pulsating SVG/CSS glowing beacon dots. Updated engine telemetry badge to Gemini 2.5 Flash and polished status tags to adhere strictly to zero-emoji platform guidelines.

3.4.60

  • Mobile AI & Platform Chat Multi-Tier Gateway: Upgraded cora_ai_chat, cora_rag_call_ai_api, cora_ai_lead_chat, and cora_ai_generate_response to use high-availability multi-provider fallback. Wired active platform OpenRouter (Gemini 2.5 Flash / google/gemini-2.5-flash) and Groq (llama-3.3-70b-versatile) gateways with proper token budgets, resolving the 'No AI provider is configured' error on mobile and desktop AI chat interfaces.

3.4.59

  • Header Action Button Leakage Fix: Scoped dynamic action button DOM injection (iCal 'Sync Calendar' and 'Share Client Link') strictly to standalone views (#cora-page-event-timeline, #cora-page-emails, #cora-page-reviews), preventing Event Itinerary buttons from leaking into the System Settings Complete Suite header.

3.4.58

  • Google Profile (GBP) Early Access & Intent Capture: Converted Google Profile into a high-converting, monochromatic Early Access & Intent Capture screen under AI Marketing. Integrated interactive GBP feature selection pills (AI Review Replies, Maps Post Scheduler, Multi-Branch Sync, Local SEO Rankings), pre-filled email registration, and AJAX waitlist intent logging via cora_capture_feature_intent.

3.4.57

  • Calendar Early Access & Intent Capture (Kept in Sidebar): Preserved the Calendar tab in the left sidebar while transforming the view into a high-converting, monochromatic Early Access & Intent Capture screen. Integrated interactive provider selection pills (Google Calendar, Outlook, Apple, Calendly), pre-filled email registration, AJAX waitlist submission controller (cora_capture_feature_intent), and feature architecture preview cards.

3.4.56

  • Analytics Tab Locked / Coming Soon: Removed Analytics from active sidebar navigation across Real Estate, Photography Studio, and Custom workspace module registries. Direct access routes display a clean, enterprise coming-soon lock card with notification registry, keeping the platform focused on core MVP modules.

3.4.55

  • Settings Suite Sidebar Sticky Scroll & Tab Consolidation: Made the settings suite left navigation sidebar sticky (sticky top-6) with independent vertical scrolling (max-h-[calc(100vh-80px)] overflow-y-auto). Consolidated redundant Activity/Audit tab entries into a single Activity Timeline & Logs navigation item.

3.4.54

  • Activity Timeline & Logs Settings Navigation Alignment: Renamed settings tab to Activity Timeline & Logs with clock icon for instant visibility under General Settings. Added query aliases (settings_tab=activity, activity-timeline, activity-logs, timeline, pulse) and automated JavaScript render triggers on tab activation for both Business Pulse and Audit Logs.

3.4.53

  • Executive Briefing Card Grid Refinement: Replaced divided linear box with clean, modern 3-column numbered card matrix for Executive Briefing takeaways. Removed wave emoji from greeting header and replaced recommendation emoji with vector SVG bulb icon adhering to zero-emoji platform rules.

3.4.52

  • Executive Briefing Block Optimization: Streamlined the Executive Briefing container layout on mobile viewports. Relocated the Workspace ID indicator into the header status row and transformed individual bulky briefing cards into a cohesive, divided card list on mobile with clean checkmark vector indicators.

3.4.51

  • Pulse Active Badge Cleanup & Mobile Responsive Polish: Removed the inner Pulse Active badge from the Executive Briefing intro card. Refined mobile viewport responsiveness across Business Pulse (compact card paddings, stacked headers, 2-column metrics grid on narrow screens, relative timestamps in mobile activity rows, and full-width action buttons).

3.4.50

  • AI Stack Header Integration & Workspace Settings Placement: Added the standard multi-platform AI branding icons stack (ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, YouTube) directly into the Business Pulse header and intro briefing section. Integrated Business Pulse as a primary tab inside the Workspace Settings Suite.

3.4.49

  • Cora Activity Timeline Rebuild as AI Business Pulse: Completely transformed Activity Timeline into Cora AI Business Pulse — a multi-tenant, workspace-isolated business activity intelligence system. Features AI executive briefings ('Here is what changed since you were last here'), ranked 'Needs Your Attention' proactive cards with 1-click action triggers, 7-day delta analytics (inbound lead velocity, overdue invoice metrics, active session counts), autonomous AI actions ledger ('Cora Worked While You Were Away'), unified filterable activity feed across CRM/Finance/Calendar/Vault/Team/AI with real-time search, and sliding event inspector context graph. Shifted legacy multi-day tour planner into Workspace Settings suite.

3.4.48

  • Dynamic Tax & Forecast Intelligence: Converted Tax & GST Intelligence tab and Cash Flow Forecast Timeline from static mock figures into authentic, workspace-scoped calculations. Workspaces with clean slates now correctly display ₹0 tax reserves, ₹0 GST collected, ₹0 ITC, ₹0 net payable, and clean empty state timeline messaging.

3.4.47

  • Purged Legacy Demo Ledger Seeding & Refined Runway Calculation: Removed automatic mock entry insertion (1000000 paise / ₹10,000) on empty ledger tables. Added automated database cleanup query to purge legacy demo setup records across workspaces, ensuring fresh tenant accounts display an authentic clean-slate baseline (₹0 cash, flat baseline trajectory, zero artificial entries).

3.4.46

  • Mobile Card Layout Optimization & JS Exception Fix: Resolved updateUrl undefined reference in tab switcher. Converted Receivables and Profitability tables on mobile devices into responsive, zero-horizontal-scroll card stacks with quick action triggers (Remind Client, Mark Paid), detailed tax/place-of-supply breakdown, aging status badges, and dual-mode live search filtering.

3.4.45

  • Workspace-Level Tenant Isolation & Clean Empty States for Finance Module: Replaced legacy platform-wide dummy mock data fallbacks with genuine tenant-scoped database queries (agency_id = %d). Invoices, ledger entries, recurring subscriptions, and custom categories now strictly isolate to individual workspaces. Built clean empty states for new tenants across Overview, Receivables, Commitments, and Profitability. Injected dynamic JavaScript data bridges for live Chart.js visualizations.

3.4.44

  • Cora Finance — Complete Rebuild as an AI Co-founder: Redesigned and rebuilt the Finance module from scratch into a proactive Financial AI Co-founder for solo founders and service businesses. Features live AI briefing ('Cora's Take'), 4 core snapshot metrics, 'Needs Your Attention' proactive actionable cards, Money In (Receivables & 1-click AI follow-ups), Money Out (Recurring Subscriptions & Cost Intelligence), Profitability & Client Economics, Project Deal Feasibility Simulator, 30/60/90-Day Cash Flow Forecast, GST/Tax Intelligence, Ask Cora Financial Copilot, and full side drawer modal architecture.

3.4.43

  • Meta WhatsApp Business Cloud API Integration & 24h Smart Cost Optimizer: Deployed official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API gateway with automatic 24-hour Customer Service Window (CSW) tracking to maximize free tier messaging, real-time connection verification, copyable webhook endpoint & verify token, and interactive live test message dispatch suite.

3.4.42

  • Mobile Media Storage Horizontal Padding & Alignment Fix: Added mx-4 margin and px-3.5 internal horizontal padding to the mobile workspace storage strip, aligning it with the toolbar search inputs and card containers across all mobile screen sizes.

3.4.41

  • Mobile Media Storage Telemetry Optimization: Relocated storage pill from cramped mobile top-bar into a sleek, dedicated sub-header progress strip with 1-tap breakdown modal, giving 'Media Library' title and AI actions full room to breathe on mobile devices.
  • Sidebar Navigation Cleanup: Removed in-development items (Automations & Workflows, Inbox, Facebook & Instagram) from sidebar navigation across Real Estate, Studio, and Custom workspace profiles.

3.4.40

  • User Avatar Status Dot SaaS Alignment: Corrected profile status indicator dot positioning across topbar, mobile header, sidebar footer, and profile popover cards. Anchored status dot to the bottom-right corner with 2px contrast border.

3.4.39

  • Workspace Storage Analytics & Genuine Footprint: Integrated full workspace-scoped storage tracking across all media assets, document vault files, and generated responsive variants with live header storage health pill and detailed category breakdown.
  • Media Module Layout Spacing Fix: Resolved empty void vertical spacing bug in media library view.
  • Single Workspace Owner Policy: Enforced strict single workspace owner per workspace with transfer workflow and distinct Super Admin badge.

3.4.20

  • Default Active Foundation Modules: Configured Custom Workspace Mode to automatically enable foundation/global-level features by default (e.g. Workspace, Sales, and AI groups) while keeping specific industry-level operational modules disabled by default.

3.4.19

  • Instant Workspace Switcher on Settings Save: Synchronized industry change selections in settings suite dropdown to browser session cookies and added client-side auto-reload to instantly refresh the workspace layout and sidebar.

3.4.18

  • Custom Workspace Mode Launch: Fully implemented Custom Workspace Mode, allowing tenants to customize their workspace by dynamically toggling individual operational and marketing modules. Configured automated metric calculations and adaptive telemetry cards on the dashboard, registered settings suite dropdown switchers, and added onboarding step support.

3.4.17

  • Unlocked Sidebar Workspace Views: Fully unlocked the 6 new workspace pages (Calendar, Activity Timeline, Automations, Inbox, Analytics, Facebook & Instagram), removing padlocks and soon badges, and integrated custom high-fidelity view files for all unlocked targets.

3.4.16

  • Sidebar Client-Side Whitelist Update: Added new navigation targets (Calendar, Activity Timeline, Automations & Workflows, Inbox, Analytics, Facebook & Instagram) to JavaScript permissions whitelists to prevent client-side hiding on page load.

3.4.15

  • Workspace Sidebar Expansion & OPcache Fix: Added 6 new sidebar navigation items to the Workspace group — Calendar, Activity Timeline, Automations & Workflows, Inbox, Analytics, and Facebook & Instagram — with SOON badges and SVG icons. Added OPcache reset to deployment pipeline to ensure PHP serves fresh bytecode after updates.

3.4.14

  • Workspace Sidebar Expansion: Added 6 new sidebar navigation items to the Workspace group — Calendar, Activity Timeline, Automations & Workflows, Inbox, Analytics, and Facebook & Instagram — with SOON badges and SVG icons. Added feature access mappings for all new slugs.

3.4.13

  • Resized Overlapping AI Brand Stack Buttons: Adjusted sizes of LLM shortcuts stack buttons in page header to exactly 32x32px on desktop and 24x24px on mobile viewports.

3.4.12

  • Removed Left Padding from Tabs Bar: Removed the left padding from the content tabs navigation bar to align it perfectly with the page title and standard content blocks.

3.4.11

  • Locked Performance & Automations: Locked the Content Performance and Automations tabs in the Content Suite. Grouped all 4 Coming Soon tabs (Calendar, Performance, Automations, Business Brain) together at the end of the navigation bar.

3.4.10

  • Calendar View Locked: Locked the Content Calendar tab in the Content Suite and disabled navigation switches, keeping it as a SOON-release tab until it is launched in a future version.

3.2.53

  • Website Statistics Card Rows Fix: Resolved duplicate curved borders and faux card shadow rendering under each stats row caused by divide-y and rounded corners collision, by implementing straight, thin divider elements between rows.

3.2.52

  • Preview Bar Touch Toggling Fix: Removed touchstart event handlers to prevent immediate double-trigger closing of the page switcher dropdown on mobile/touch screens.
  • Elementor Router & Page Switcher Fix: Fixed routing fallback in cora_canvas_theme_frontend_router so page_id parameter correctly resolves to the active page preview instead of falling back to the homepage. Unified the Elementor preview bar with the high-fidelity custom dropdown component.
  • Preview Cache Prevention: Integrated nocache_headers() to prevent local caching of draft theme assets.

3.2.51

  • Preview Bar Dropdown Fix: Restored dropdown toggling and absolute-positioned custom monochromatic page dropdown selector rendering.

3.2.50

  • Lovable Preview Router URL Mapping Fix: Fixed route redirection and history state mismatches so that selecting a page from the floating preview bar dropdown loads the actual page design instead of falling back to the homepage design.

3.2.49

  • Lovable Connector Revamp: Overhauled the Lovable studio drawer connector and routing mapper. Synced WordPress page template interception to resolve draft preview rendering bugs, routing proxy paths to the live URL, and integrated automatic WordPress page creation directly into the Git Sync execution pipeline with seamless sessionStorage wizard step state persistence.

3.2.48

  • Centered Modals & Enhanced Floating Backlink Badge: Converted Add Page, Menu Item, Rename Page, Change Page Slug, and Theme Rename sliding drawers into centered popup modals with zoom animations. Enlarged the floating 'Made in Cora' backlink badge with 20px border radius, bigger font, and no outline styling.

3.2.40

  • Enhanced Media Modal Select Button & Redundant Handler Cleanup: Upgraded the global wp.media wrapper to inject a premium monochromatic floating CTA button that clones the native toolbar button text, syncs selection state changes, and programmatically triggers the native hidden button on click. Removed ~150 lines of redundant local open-event button injection listeners from coraOpenMediaSelector and coraOpenMediaUploader, eliminating race conditions and duplicate button flickering across all workspace media selectors.

3.2.39

  • Global WordPress Media Modal Visibility Override Fix: Resolved a critical usability bug where the primary 'Select' or 'Insert' button and bottom action toolbar in the media library modal became invisible or unresponsive. Registered a global JS wrapper hook on wp.media and introduced precise CSS resets to guarantee native select controls remain 100% visible, correctly styled, and interactable across all workspace drawers and media selectors.

3.2.38

  • Enhanced User Financial Profile: Restructured Financials tab in Edit User drawer to group fields into clean, visual cards with dynamic split share previewer, payout preferences, and GST tax registration controls.
  • User Actions Expansion & Security: Added Active Session Revocation and next-login forced password change redirection workflow.
  • Platform AI Stack & Active Members Avatars: Integrated multi-platform AI branding logos and enabled native profile picture/Gravatar fallback rendering in active members view.

3.2.37

  • Mobile Responsive Table View Empty State Refinement: Add class overrides for .cora-empty-state-row to make sure empty state message rows render as clean, centered, full-width rows without any blocky card transformations on mobile devices.

3.2.36

  • Automations Badge Wrapping Optimization: Added whitespace-nowrap styling to the active workflows status badge and dynamic lists to prevent text wrapping on narrow layout viewports.

3.2.35

  • Premium Full-Page AI Chat & Search Sync: Converted the inline AI sidebar drawer into a fixed full-screen overlay with centered reading blocks. Deployed truly dynamic universal command search indexing active team members and public developer documentation. Integrated RAG knowledge base sync updates for users/invitations activity logs and launched a searchable developer documentation engine.

3.2.34
